scope: One hypothetical ward; sequential decluttering plus unchanged residual cleaning. Illustrative assumptions, not measured hospital economics.

normalization_reference.basis: Fixed reference case inherited from the starter: 5.2 assumed clutter staff-minutes plus 10 assumed residual staff-minutes. One cost unit is that reference year's productive staff labour cost; no wage or procurement quote is asserted. Reference values stay fixed when active scenarios change.

daily_rooms.basis: Legacy ward throughput, unverified; not the separate 30-discharge hospital case.

operating_hours.basis: Arrivals spread across an assumed eight-hour dispatch window; not observed hospital arrivals.

parallel_cells.basis: One dedicated robot per housekeeping service cell; c also scales capital and fixed maintenance.

manual_clutter_elapsed_min.basis: Legacy starter value; no matching manual decluttering time study is available.

manual_clutter_staff_min.basis: Assumes one worker actively clears clutter throughout the 5.2-minute manual stage.

residual_elapsed_min.basis: Unverified residual cleaning duration; held identical in manual and assisted cases. CDC-PROC supports retaining cleaning/disinfection scope, not this numeric duration.

residual_staff_min.basis: Unverified residual staff requirement; unchanged between cases.

handling_elapsed_min.basis: Illustrative setup/release time outside the robot cycle.

handling_staff_min.basis: Illustrative active setup/release labour, additional to monitoring and residual work.

monitoring_fraction.unit: fraction of robot elapsed time attended
monitoring_fraction.basis: Unvalidated 5% attendance scenario; full attendance remains available in sensitivity. Not demonstrated by MuJoCo autonomy.

cash_realization_fraction.unit: fraction of released labour value converted to reduced expenditure
cash_realization_fraction.basis: Conservative default: reallocated staff remain employed, so time released does not automatically reduce payroll. EFFICIENCY distinguishes cash and non-cash benefits.

pilot_success_probability.basis: Illustrative failure allowance while final trials run. Explicitly NOT estimated as 100% from one successful pilot. Ignored in final-data mode.

pilot_failure_attempt_min.basis: Uses the experiment's 1800-second horizon as an illustrative upper-bound failed-cycle scenario, not a measured failed-cycle mean. Ignored in final-data mode.

capex_ratio_per_cell.unit: reference annual labour-cost units per robot
capex_ratio_per_cell.basis: Legacy illustrative capital ratio; not a supplier quote. No currency or validated purchase cost is claimed.

maintenance_ratio_per_cell_year.unit: reference annual labour-cost units per robot-year
maintenance_ratio_per_cell_year.basis: Illustrative maintenance ratio for sensitivity, not measured maintenance or a vendor estimate.

energy_ratio_reference_year.unit: reference annual labour-cost units at reference annual throughput
energy_ratio_reference_year.basis: Illustrative energy/consumables allowance scales with room count. MuJoCo squared actuator effort is NOT electrical energy.

life_years.basis: Illustrative service life; not a warranty or measured robot life.

sources.title: Audited 16-object MuJoCo pilot, seed 9010
sources.supports: One measured simulated successful clearing duration only. No human labour, clinical effect, reliability population estimate or procurement cost.

sources.title: CDC Environmental Cleaning Procedures, section 4.2.3
sources.supports: Terminal cleaning after discharge includes cleaning/disinfection beyond decluttering; those tasks remain in the model. Does not validate the 10-minute assumption.

sources.title: UK Government Efficiency Framework, sections 4.1-4.5
sources.supports: Separates direct spending reductions from time/productivity benefits without a reduced budget. No UK financial rate is imported into this Indian academic scenario.

sources.title: Barts Health: How co-bots are creating a cleaner future, 29 April 2026
sources.supports: Qualitative example of cleaning staff time reallocation. Different robots/tasks; no numeric transfer to our manipulator.

sources.title: Larson and Odoni, Urban Operations Research, section 4.6.2 (MIT-hosted text)
sources.supports: Identical exponential servers, Poisson arrivals, FCFS and infinite waiting capacity for M/M/c. These assumptions are illustrative here, not fitted to hospital data.
